title: Drunk Wisconsin Snowbird Caught Driving Golf Cart!
description:
On May 7th, 2022, at around 11 pm, officers in Florida were on patrol when they saw an illegally driving golf cart with no lights traveling on a County Road.

The driver provided a breath sample which read 0.116 BAC and 0.115 BAC at the jail. 

After court proceedings, a Florida Judge dropped the DUI charge against the driver based on the lead officer’s statements captured on the bodycam footage.
